svg.title: Server-side State Machines and Their Interaction

g.text: Server-side State Machines and Their Interaction
do / wait for admitted [WorkItem]s to complete
Work: kProviderBusy if no idle worker.
Cleanup: queued if no idle worker,
[worker thread after R4, or directly on R2 / R3 error]
[after registry lock release; starts cleanup if ready]
admitted work items drain before cleanup
[only after S5, so cleanup jobs (D5) can still be submitted]
calls DetachAllConnections() [every client is marked kCleanupPending, begins session draining, then loses its mapping]
[blocks until D8 completed for all clients]
for every detached Session after registry unlock, continues as D4 to D8
Solid arrows: state transitions (label = trigger [action / guard]),
drawn in the colour of the flow whose call triggers them.
Yellow boxes: independent roots (callbacks of the SCORE message-passing
Dashed arrows: cross-machine interactions, one arrow per source,
target and colour; the numbers in its label give the order.
State activities (entry / do / exit) name the call made into another
state machine while in that state, with the same flow number; the
target machine is given in square brackets.
R1-R7 (green): OnRequest, admission, submission, execution, response.
S1-S2 (blue): ServerStateMachine Start() from kStopped through kStarting.
S3-S6 (orange): ServerStateMachine Stop() / WaitForTermination() from kStopping.
Session::Respond() is only allowed while the Session is kActive.
